name: Great Northern Metal Co.

about:
Great Northern Metal Co. is based in Bozeman, Montana. The company opened in November 2019. Founder Rainor grew up in the Gallatin Valley and started the business with his brother and friends after founding several other ventures. Ownership details are not explicitly stated beyond the founding group.

The company supplies metal roofing and siding systems for commercial, residential, and agricultural buildings. It operates as a supplier and service provider, offering material selection support, project consultation, and coordination with architects and contractors. The team includes an owner/production role and a production manager, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include architects, roofing contractors, and building owners across Montana and a 500-mile radius around Bozeman. Projects range from rustic mountain lodges to commercial metal roofing work and agricultural structures.

The company emphasizes honest information drawn from over 15 years of industry experience, precise orders, accurate lead times, and quality products. It positions itself as a value-driven supplier that prioritizes clear communication and reliable timelines.
